hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/bash_guard.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 -I "$f"; else echo "WARNING: $f is missing, so this command ran without the Bash guard. Tell the lead integrator; restore the file with the Write tool from the copy on the integration branch." >&2; exit 1; fi
jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --select E9,F63,F7,F82 "$f"; }
